integration-copy-rest:
curl -X POST https://search-agent-api-develop-43b3.up.railway.app/v1/query \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"text": "Which diseases are associated with BRCA1?", "session_id": "demo-1"}'
integration-copy-graphql:
curl -X POST https://search-agent-api-develop-43b3.up.railway.app/graphql \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"query": "mutation { ask(input: { text: \"Which diseases are associated with BRCA1?\", sessionId: \"demo-1\" }) { answer citations { source sourceUrl } } }"}'
integration-copy-cli:
s3 login --base-url https://search-agent-api-develop-43b3.up.railway.app you@example.org
s3 ask "diseases linked to BRCA1"
